rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something physically passes through a barrier or darkness.

example.english: The laser can penetrate the thick wall and illuminate the inside.
example.traditional: 激光穿透厚厚嘅牆，照到入面。
example.jyutping: gik1 gwong1 cyun1 tau3 hau5 hau5 ge3 coeng4 ziu3 dou3 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when understanding gets beneath an obstacle, obscure wording, or someone’s real meaning.

example.english: I had to read the sentence several times to penetrate its real meaning.
example.traditional: 我睇咗幾次，先至睇透呢句說話嘅真正意思。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 sin1 zi3 tai2 tau3 ne1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 ge3 zan1 zing3 ji3 si1

rows.note: Use this when a feeling, story, or experience affects someone deeply.

example.english: This story really manages to penetrate my heart.
example.traditional: 呢個故事真係好打動我。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 zan1 hai6 hou2 daa2 dung6 ngo5
